description: This file defines the 'UpdateFilter' class, which is a servlet filter responsible for managing OpenMRS database updates via Liquibase during application startup and maintenance. It handles user authentication for superusers, coordinates database update execution in a separate thread, and manages the update process lifecycle, including error handling and user interface interactions.

classes.name: UpdateFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that manages the database update process for OpenMRS, including user authentication, coordinating Liquibase changelog application, and controlling the update lifecycle during server startup or maintenance.

classes.name: UpdateFilter.UpdateFilterCompletion
classes.description: An inner class that handles the execution and monitoring of the database update process in a separate thread, including error handling, warnings, and reporting status.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to initiate the update wizard, primarily rendering the initial page.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests for processing user actions such as authentication, initiating updates, and AJAX polling for update progress.

methods.name: checkLocaleAttributesForFirstTime
methods.description: Sets the user's locale attribute in the session at the first request based on the request locale or system defaults.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user as a superuser by verifying credentials against the database.

methods.name: isSuperUser
methods.description: Checks if the user with the given user ID has the superuser role.

methods.name: startOpenmrs
methods.description: Initializes the OpenMRS application context and starts the web daemon.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, determining whether updates are required based on database state and configuration.

methods.name: getUpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Retrieves the update filter's model object.

methods.name: skipFilter
methods.description: Determines if the filter should be skipped based on the current request context.

methods.name: updatesRequired
methods.description: Static method indicating whether updates are required.

methods.name: setUpdatesRequired
methods.description: Static method to set the updates required flag.

methods.name: isLockReleased
methods.description: Checks if the database lock has been released.

methods.name: setLockReleased
methods.description: Sets the database lock released flag.

methods.name: getTemplatePrefix
methods.description: Returns the path prefix for Velocity templates.
